headline: Elden Ring
title: Elden Ring Facts | George R R Martin Worldbuilding | Classic Games
video_script: Elden Ring, from FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco, came out in twenty twenty two. Author George R. R. Martin worked on the worldbuilding and backstory, while Hidetaka Miyazaki remained lead writer of the main story. It won Game of the Year at The Game Awards twenty twenty two. Which boss made you quit first? Comment below!
description: Elden Ring by FromSoftware won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2022; George R. R. Martin did worldbuilding. Sources: Wikipedia, PC Gamer, GamesRadar.
joke: The tutorial is just you dying politely to the first knight.
